items.title: Robert Glasper interviewed by Greg Thomas, Clinton, New York, February 20, 2016

ctx.x: Each genre has a particular vibe and it’s very egotistical — a lot of jazz musicians think because they have a lot of chops that every other music is easy to play and you can just do it. But that’s not the case.

Well T.S. Monk, Thelonious Monk’s son, who for years played in R&B, he made it very clear, he’s like, you know, you’re playing that? Can you keep that time right there? Can you keep it there? Can you keep it there like that?
Right. Bum-bum-be. Yeah. That’s T.S. That’s my cousin-in-law.
